events.title: Día de Muertos
events.when: Limited time · runs alongside Halloween all next weekend
events.body: Arrived in v609. The Muertos mutation pays ×15, tied with Spooky for the best. Limited Eternals Catrina Matadora (147M/s) and Pavoloco (62M/s) each have a 1% chance to spawn with Muertos. Since v610, waves can't force Muertos onto them.

events.title: Chill Hour
events.when: 4 times a day · 1 hour · ends as the Admin Machine rolls
events.body: The hour players use for safe trades in public servers. You'll see "MM or Chill Hour only" all over the trade channels.

events.title: Event waves
events.when: Exact times from the official Steal the Brainrot tracker (#ballerina-events). The tracker reshuffles, so times can move
events.body: During a wave, brainrots on the conveyor can roll that wave's mutation.

events.title: Halloween V2
events.body: 10× chance to get Halloween brainrots. Old brainrots can roll Spooky during a wave. Halloween and Muertos mutations can cross over while both are running.

events.title: Spooky Daily Pass
events.body: Daily Halloween rewards on a free and a premium track. Places 18–24 were added in v606, including a Level 225 Spooky Secret on premium.

events.title: Weekend codes
events.when: 72 hours from the Admin Abuse show
events.body: 715308 · 4× Cash Multi. 428197 · Muertos Wave + Skibidi + Tung. Saturday's 530471, 847192 and 206853 run out about a day earlier.

events.title: Halloween Machine
events.body: Limited machine with 11 new brainrots. Max it to 130M/s total income for the best odds. Put in 5 of the new Halloween brainrots for a 1% shot at Il Jackoleros.

events.title: Luck Tier 13
events.when: Unlocks at luck level 685 · luck gate every 30 s
events.body: Higher odds for every Eternal, Absolute and GOAT, and a guaranteed Eternal from its own pool at the end of a show. Pavoloco is 1 in 909 here (1 in 250 with 4×).

events.title: Admin Abuse
events.when: Weekends · next one runs longer, time not announced yet
events.body: Sunday's show (v613): every boost and event on, two Muertos waves and 15 Muertos Secrets at levels 190 to 235. Eternal BoxRot on 20% of servers, Insane Eternal BoxRot on 10%. Next weekend both Muertos and Halloween run the whole time.

events.title: Rare spawns
events.when: One per server during Admin Abuse
events.body: This week: El Crunchador (Lv 226, 14%), Burguro dan Fryuro (Lv 228, 8%), DiggoBlock (Lv 230, 3%), Lady Pegasina (Lv 234, 1.5%), Wreckzilla (Lv 238, 0.3%).

events.title: Mini-game
events.body: Delayed while Ferins frees up map space.

leaks.body: Live stats differ from the datamine: Catrina Matadora 147M/s (2.2B/s with Muertos), Pavoloco 62M/s (930M/s with Muertos). Both are limited.

leaks.body: The other two Day of the Dead Eternals are still unreleased. Datamined at Jackodusa 51M/s ($102B) and Spectrella 187M/s ($374B).

leaks.body: Most picks are 6–7% (Garbagzilla and Cannone Maledettone 7%). Rarest: Scorpidusa Spiderusa and Bullzilla at 0.5%, Harpanzee and Magico Moonman at 1%.
leaks.title: Tier 13 guaranteed Eternal odds

leaks.body: Minimum 4 traits (was 3). 8+ traits: 3.3% → 11%. 10 traits: 1 in 4,022 → 1 in 362.

leaks.body: The new mini-game is on hold while map space is freed up. No release date.
